what: Tier 1 entry v2: the wave-2 ships with every fine-tuned clip the no-regression rule adopts
note: Improves all four boards against what is uploaded and clears CHORD's 0.51038 by +0.0165. The strong-four arm (e03 e08 e15 e27) added three adoptions: e08 +0.258, e15 +0.160, e27 +0.079; e03 came back 0.750 against its 0.781 record and was rejected. The earlier 0.50838 figure was a packer bug, not a packing artifact: ws_chain was appended to the rollout search and became the last match, so the entry shipped the generation-2 e00 (0.8078) and e12 (0.8013) in place of gen-1 rollouts that scored 0.8654 and 0.8839. The packer now reads results/t1_chain_adoption.json.

tier1_finetune_headroom: Closed. All 7 clips never fine-tuned (e05 0.266, e07 0.251, e14 0.206, e13 0.159, e25 0.133, e19 0.116, e28 0.089) sit below 0.30, and the measured rule is that 0 of 4 clips below 0.35 adopted while 11 of 19 above it did.
